Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge hits back at the BJP over the Tipu Sultan Jayanti controversy, questioning the RSS's role in India's freedom struggle. In this media interaction, the leader also responds to the controversy surrounding Sonia Gandhi's autobiography, minority army training programmes, the knife parcel sent to Chalavadi Narayanaswamy and allegations involving Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy. Watch the key political exchanges from Karnataka.
Thank you for watching our video!
